mapper.sql: e.id, e.enrollment_no AS enrollmentNo, e.training_class_id AS trainingClassId, tc.class_code AS classCode, tc.class_name AS className, c.course_name AS courseName, e.student_id AS studentId, student.user_name AS studentUserName, e.snapshot_real_name AS realName, e.snapshot_id_card AS idCard, e.snapshot_organization AS organization, e.snapshot_position AS position, e.snapshot_phone AS phone, e.status, e.review_reason AS reviewReason, e.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, reviewer.real_name AS reviewerName, e.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, tc.start_date AS startDate, tc.end_date AS endDate, tc.location, tc.fee, po.id AS paymentOrderId, po.order_no AS orderNo, po.status AS paymentStatus, po.amount AS paymentAmount, po.transaction_no AS transactionNo, po.paid_at AS paidAt, e.create_time AS createTime

FROM t_training_enrollment e JOIN t_training_class tc ON tc.id = e.training_class_id AND tc.is_deleted = 0 JOIN t_course c ON c.id = tc.course_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 JOIN t_user student ON student.id = e.student_id AND student.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_user reviewer ON reviewer.id = e.reviewed_by AND reviewer.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_payment_order po ON po.enrollment_id = e.id AND po.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_training_enrollment WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM t_training_enrollment WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND training_class_id = #{trainingClassId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ADMITTED') AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_training_enrollment WHERE training_class_id = #{trainingClassId} AND status = 'ADMITTED' AND is_deleted = 0
